key_insight: CALF-Wrapper combines a pretrained RL policy with a proven fallback controller, inheriting the fallback’s goal-reaching and goal-maintenance guarantees under stated assumptions.
engineering_relevance: It offers a way to deploy high-performing RL control with goal-reaching guarantees without additional dynamics models, online learning, or runtime constrained optimization.
method: Start with a pretrained RL base policy and a fallback controller that provably reaches and maintains the goal.
Use the base policy’s critic estimate to select between the two policies during deployment.
Establish goal-reaching guarantees and probability bounds on settling time and maximum distance from the goal.
evidence_signal: Four simulated control environments compare CALF-Wrapper with base, fallback, and constrained-RL policies; experiments report effective performance and the maximum possible observed goal-reaching rate, with sensitivity and ablation studies.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on the stated assumptions and a valid fallback controller; simulation results do not establish real-world reliability.
paper_title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
